name: jmsh
description: An HTML app of iPhone 4 interfaces for interaction with Home Assistant.

scripts.clean:tmp: rm -rf tmp && mkdir tmp && mkdir tmp/html
scripts.dev:js: babel src/js/vendor src/js/main.js src/views/**/*.js --out-file dist/js/main.js --source-maps inline --presets=@babel/preset-env
scripts.build:sass: npm run dev:sass -- --no-source-map && postcss tmp/css/*.css --use autoprefixer -d dist/css
scripts.build:html: html-import-partials src/views/**/*.html -o tmp/html && html-minifier --input-dir tmp/html --output-dir dist --file-ext html --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-script-type-attributes --remove-tag-whitespace  --minify-css true --minify-js true
scripts.start: npm run clean:dist && npm run clean:dsstore && npm run clean:tmp && npm-run-all dev:js --parallel watch:sass watch:views watch:partials watch:js watch:svg watch:launch watch:m4a serve
scripts.build: npm run clean:dist && npm run clean:dsstore && npm run clean:tmp && npm-run-all build:sass build:js && npm run build:html
